name: encoding-reflection-type-assert-on-a-field
description: A call reflect.TypeAssert[I](v) asserts I on what v.Interface() returns, exactly as v.Interface().(I) does, so it is judged as that assertion: a generic bind fills a struct by reflection, ranging over its fields with Fields, and reaches a field type's method only through reflect.TypeAssert of an interface on each field's value, which retains the method the interface requires.
